provenance: Hand-picked demo shocks. Not calibrated to AAPL price history, Morpho rate history, or vault withdrawal history.

scenarios.label: AAPL price falls 20%
scenarios.rationale: A sharp equity sell-off. Morpho's oracle and Crest's feed-only price fall together, so the oracle gap stays the same.

scenarios.label: AAPL price falls 35%
scenarios.rationale: A severe drawdown that pushes a position sitting at the target band past the critical threshold.

scenarios.label: Borrow APY up 6 points, vault APY down 1 point
scenarios.rationale: Utilization on the AAPL market jumps while vault yield softens. On 2026-09-17 Crest recorded a 24h borrow APY of 7.93% against a six-hour vault APY of 3.91%, so an inverted spread is not hypothetical.

scenarios.label: Vault exit liquidity falls to zero
scenarios.rationale: The vault's liquidity market is fully borrowed, so no strategy assets can be withdrawn to repay debt until it frees up.
